what: Refactor internal/db into cohesive files with versioned migrations
why: internal/db/db.go had 453 lines mixing 4 responsibilities (connection pool, schema DDL, ad-hoc migrations, project CRUD). Split into db.go (public API), pool.go (Pool/NewDBPool), and migrations.go (schema + schema_migrations versioned system). This improves maintainability without external dependencies or API changes.
learned: For Go database layers without CGO, use a schema_migrations table + in-code migration functions + columnExists helper instead of ad-hoc PRAGMA table_info checks. Keep zero external migration dependencies by using versioned migration functions in Go code.
author: Mario Sandoval (Sv Tech)
